purpose: Teach: 冬季/転換期/引き揚げ/大出/炎上/踏み切っ/杏/撒き

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、本気で、絶対、冬季、絶対、流行する、絶対、感染症、絶対、医療界、絶対、注視しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, winter always brings a surge in infectious diseases. We're watching closely at the hospital.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact opening. Clear medical authority without condescension. Even pace, grounded. Meets his eyes briefly—the clarity of someone who sees difficult things regularly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療の、本気で、絶対、転換期、絶対、研究、絶対、進めていらっしゃるんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: So the medical field is going through a real transition right now—your research is part of pushing that forward.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly tentative. Genuine curiosity underneath—he's piecing something together. Soft pause before 'transition,' like he's catching his own insight mid-thought.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。海外医療チーム、本気で、絶対、引き揚げ、絶対、後の、絶対、現地支援、絶対、続けております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. When overseas teams withdrew, we didn't just leave. We stayed to support the local healthcare systems.
lines.style: Direct, purposeful. Each clause lands with quiet intention. No flourish—just factual reporting of what matters. A small note of pride in the staying.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 救急現場の、本気で、絶対、大出血、絶対、対応、絶対、医療界、絶対、訓練、絶対、徹底されているんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The emergency departments are rigorous about training for massive bleeds. The protocols are thorough.
lines.style: Responsive to his genuine question. Warmth in the confirmation. Slightly slower pace on 'rigorous'—she's acknowledging what he asked was worth asking. Steady breathing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの治療法、本気で、絶対、誤情報の炎上、絶対、医療界、絶対、対応に困っています、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, but we're struggling with something else—misinformation spreading about treatments, and it makes our job harder.
lines.style: Shift to something heavier. Exhale on the opening 'Yes.' Weariness surfaces briefly here—the kind that lives in her shoulders, not her voice. Honest admission of difficulty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新治療に、本気で、絶対、踏み切った、絶対、決断、絶対、患者さんを救いますね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: When we commit to a new treatment, it's to save lives. That decision doesn't come lightly.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not defensive—clarifying. Slight emphasis on 'commit,' like he's touched on something she needs to be clear about. Steady, almost protective tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんに、本気で、絶対、杏、絶対、由来の薬効、絶対、ご紹介、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We introduced patients to apricot-derived treatments when the evidence supported it.
lines.style: Clinical but not cold. Straightforward presentation of fact. Slight warmth in 'introduced'—she cares that patients know their options. Patient, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 種撒き、本気で、絶対、活動を、絶対、健康促進、絶対、と、絶対、組み合わせる、絶対、取り組み、絶対、続いていますね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The work continues—seed cultivation paired with health promotion. Both together, building something real.
lines.style: Closing observation, almost reflective. Slower pace. Slight trailing-off on 'real,' like she's seeing the longer arc of it. Quiet satisfaction, grounded exhaustion underneath.
